SELECT
    r."name",
    r."address",
    r."service_format",
    r."hours"
FROM "restaurant" r
WHERE (
        LOWER(r."service_format") LIKE '%buffet%'
        OR LOWER(r."service_format") LIKE '%coffee%'
      )
  
  AND r."hours" IS NOT NULL
  AND r."hours" ~ '^\s*\d{1,2}:\d{2}\s*-\s*\d{1,2}:\d{2}\s*$'
  AND (
        SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(r."hours", '-', 1), ':', 1)::int * 60
        + SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(r."hours", '-', 1), ':', 2)::int
      ) <= (7 * 60 + 30)
  AND (
        SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(r."hours", '-', 2), ':', 1)::int * 60
        + SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(r."hours", '-', 2), ':', 2)::int
      ) >= (16 * 60)
ORDER BY r."name" ASC NULLS FIRST;
